title: "Compare GC with more precise tn5 bias"
output: html_document

# Getting the data

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(Rsamtools)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(Biostrings)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

# Random regions

```{r regions, eval=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
nRegions <- 30000L
regionWidth <- 300L
chrLen <- seqlengths(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)[["chr9"]]
starts <- sample.int(chrLen - regionWidth + 1L, 2*nRegions)
regions <- GRanges("chr9", IRanges(starts, width=regionWidth))
seqs <- getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, regions)
keep <- which(letterFrequency(seqs, "N") == 0)
stopifnot(length(keep) >= nRegions)
keep <- keep[seq_len(nRegions)]
regions <- sort(regions[keep])
regions$region <- paste0("chr9:", start(regions), "-", end(regions))
regBam <- regions
seqlevels(regBam) <- "9"
```

# Counts & bias

```{r counts, eval=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(weightedMotifAccess)
  library(tn5bias)
})
cntf <- function(regions, ...){
  se <- peakCountsFromBAM("nakedDNA.bam", regions, paired=TRUE, ignore.strand=TRUE, 
                          verbose=FALSE, ...)
  as.integer(assay(se, "counts")[,1])
}
d <- data.frame(overlap=cntf(regBam, type="full", ov.type="any"),
                insertions_ends=cntf(regBam, type="ends", ov.type="any"))
                
regPad <- regBam
ranges(regPad) <- IRanges(start(regBam)-1L, end(regBam)+1L)
spanning <- cntf(regPad, type="full", ov.type="within")
uniqueIns <- d$overlap - spanning
d$insertions_unique <- uniqueIns
d$GC <- as.numeric(letterFrequency(getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, regions),
                                 "GC", as.prob=TRUE))
bs <- getRegionTn5Bias(regions, BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, method=c("mean","max","quantile"), 
                       q=c(0.9, 0.98), log2=TRUE, verbose=FALSE)
colnames(bs) <- paste0("bias_", c("mean","max","q0.9","q0.98"))

d <- cbind(d,bs)
con <- gzfile("nakedDNA_random300bp_regions.csv.gz", "w")
write.table(d, con, sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
close(con)
```

```{r compare}
d <- read.delim("nakedDNA_random300bp_regions.csv.gz")
d$bias_q0.98 <- NULL
names(bvals) <- bvals <- grep("bias_",colnames(d),value=TRUE)
de <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c(GC=NA, bvals), \(x){
  if(is.na(x)){
    f <- "overlap ~ ns(GC,2)"
  }else{
    f <- paste0("overlap ~ ", x)
  }
  m <- glm(as.formula(f), family=quasipoisson, data=d)
  de1 <- round(1 - m$deviance / m$null.deviance, 3)
  de1 <- paste0(" ", f, " : ", de1, "\n")
  if(is.na(x)) return(data.frame(lab=de1))
  f <- paste0("overlap ~ ns(GC,2) + ", x)
  m <- glm(as.formula(f), family=quasipoisson, data=d)
  de2 <- round(1 - m$deviance / m$null.deviance, 3)
  de2 <- paste0(" ", f, " : ", de2)
  data.frame(lab=paste0(de1,de2))
}), .id="type")

names(vars) <- vars <- colnames(d)[-1:-3]
ag <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(vars, \(x){
  ag <- aggregate(d[,c(x,"overlap")],
                  by=list(x=cut(d[[x]], quantile(d[[x]], (0:50)/50))), FUN=mean)
  colnames(ag)[2] <- "bias"
  ag[,-1]
}), .id="type")


p2 <- ggplot(d, aes(GC, bias_mean)) + 
  ggrastr::rasterize(ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(), dpi = 150) + 
  labs(x="GC content", y="Mean bias across region") + theme_bw()
p3 <- ggplot(ag, aes(bias, overlap)) + geom_point() + theme_bw() +
    labs(x="Bias (quantile bins)", y="Average number of overlaps") +
    geom_text(data=de, aes(x=-Inf, y=3.2, label=lab), hjust=0, vjust=1, size=3.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~type, scale="free_x")
```

```{r}
data("tn5biasMotif")
mo <- universalmotif::view_motifs(tn5biasMotif, use.type="PPM", text.size = 11) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:10, labels = c(-5:-1, 1:5)) +
  labs(x="Position relative to the cut site", y="Probability")
```

```{r}
e <- read.csv("nakedDNA_bias_vs_insertions_percentiles.csv")
co <- cor(e$mean_log2bias, log10(e$mean_insertions_per_position))
p1 <- ggplot(e[which(e$population=="all" & e$track=="shifted"),],
       aes(mean_insertions_per_position, mean_log2bias)) + geom_point() + 
  scale_x_log10() + theme_bw() + 
  annotate(geom="text", x=0.00015, y=2, hjust=0,
           label=paste("Pearson correlation: ", round(co,3))) +
  labs(x="Mean number of insertions in bias percentile bin", y="Mean log2(bias)")
```


```{r plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
pdf("tn5_bias.pdf", width=10, height=9)
plot_grid(plot_grid(p1, p2, labels=LETTERS[1:2], scale=0.95, nrow=1),
          plot_grid(p3, scale=0.95, labels="C"),
          nrow=2, rel_heights = c(2,4))
dev.off()
```
